name: StopLossTakeProfitATR
longCondition: el_gt(ctx.OpenPositionProfit(), rewardRisk * riskPts * ctx.BigPointValue()) || el_lt(ctx.OpenPositionProfit(), -riskPts * ctx.BigPointValue())
shortCondition: el_gt(ctx.OpenPositionProfit(), rewardRisk * riskPts * ctx.BigPointValue()) || el_lt(ctx.OpenPositionProfit(), -riskPts * ctx.BigPointValue())
